class.name: SpineSlot
class.description: Stores a slot's current pose. Slots organize attachments for skeleton draw order purposes and provide a place to store state for an attachment. State cannot be stored in an attachment itself because attachments are stateless and may be shared across multiple skeletons. Use [code]get_pose()[/code] or [code]get_applied_pose()[/code] to read or change color, attachment, and deform values.

method.name: get_applied_pose
method.description: Returns the pose last applied to the skeleton by [code]SpineAnimationState.apply()[/code].

method.name: get_bone
method.description: Returns the bone this slot belongs to.

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns the slot's setup pose data.

method.name: get_pose
method.description: Returns the current pose for this slot, containing color, attachment, and deform data.

method.name: set_to_setup_pose
method.description: Sets this slot to the setup pose.
